The '''Holessians''' were portly [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] native to [[Holess]], believed to be related to the [[Lannik (species)/Legends|Lannik]]. They were obsessed with law and regarded legal cases like a sport, although betting on outcomes was considered sacrilege. They revered judges like gods and regarded lawyers as celebrities.
